name: Broken Access Control
description: Restrict access so authenticated users cannot act outside their intended permissions.

name: Cryptographic Failures
description: Protect data in transit and at rest with strong, correctly implemented cryptography.

name: Injection
description: Validate, sanitize, and parameterize untrusted input to prevent injection flaws.

name: Insecure Design
description: Use secure design patterns and threat modeling to address risks before implementation.

name: Security Misconfiguration
description: Harden and consistently review application, framework, and infrastructure configuration.

name: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
description: Track, patch, and remove components with known vulnerabilities.

name: Identification and Authentication Failures
description: Correctly implement authentication and session management to prevent identity compromise.

name: Software and Data Integrity Failures
description: Verify the integrity of software updates, critical data, and CI/CD pipelines.

name: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
description: Log, monitor, and alert on security-relevant events to enable timely incident response.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
description: Validate and restrict server-initiated requests to prevent access to unintended resources.
